description: Pay for x402 v2 requests from .NET: a DelegatingHandler that answers HTTP 402 by signing an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization and replaying the request, with per-asset spending limits (EURC and USDC never share a cap).

Accept x402 v2 payments in ASP.NET Core: route-pricing middleware, an imperative payment gate for request-dependent prices, a resilient facilitator client, an idempotency ledger that settles each authorization at most once, and start-up validation. Never holds a signing key.
Core types, JSON contracts, transport codec and verified EURC/USDC asset profiles for the x402 v2 payment protocol. No ASP.NET Core, signing or network dependency.
